mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies and 63 degrees at Harriet Park. Please be aware that the air quality index is currently at 55, which is in the moderate range.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for seniors, while the Recreation Department is currently seeking enthusiastic individuals for adult fitness instructor positions.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly police report, on Thursday, July 30th, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being cited for operating without a valid license after the officer detected the odor of marijuana.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Turtle flavor.
